@@ -5220,3 +5220,4 @@
-// Only the acquiring variants of CompareAndSwapX, GetAndSetX and GetAndAddX are
-// defined here: needs_acquiring_load_reserved() always returns true for these
-// opcodes (see is_CAS()), so the non-acquiring variants are unreachable.
+// CompareAndSwapX, GetAndSetX, and GetAndAddX represent sequentially
+// consistent operations. C2 therefore emits a trailing MemBarAcquire for
+// these nodes, so their RISC-V implementation always needs acquire semantics.
+// Non-acquiring match rules would consequently be unreachable.
